# Retained Work conversation context

Harvested on 2026-09-22 from the retained Work briefing for turn
`3cb9b4d1-68b5-4ae3-8928-b221833423e2`, visible through its Raw context disclosure
on `/timeline/ingress-input%3A2b6e9fb1-996b-4eab-bcfd-f448d69bab4e`.

The fixture retains all eleven earlier messages' original actor, text and time,
the summary fields and the unchanged manifest. Unrelated current/root message
fields and each message's source-read metadata are omitted. The manifest's byte
count describes the original bundle, not this excerpt.

The page treated Work's `conversation_context.bundle` as routing's flat
`conversation_context`, so it falsely said the messages were not retained and
omitted both summary explanations. The same nested sections had no prompt
highlights.
